name: Ferrodraco
sum: Crested anhanguerid from the Cenomanian–Turonian Winton Formation of Queensland — one of the most complete pterosaurs from Australia.
material: Front of skull and lower jaws, 40 loose teeth, five neck vertebrae, shoulder joint and parts of the left wing.
biology: Anhanguerids are generally interpreted as fish-eaters; Ferrodraco had a high premaxillary crest and a toothed snout not expanded into a rosette.
author: Pentland et al. 2019
